title: Comparison of the two pullbacks, finite coefficients
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and chosen uniformizer $\varpi$, and an integer $n\geq1$. Put $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $\square=(f,f',g,g',\alpha)$ be a Cartesian square of schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], with arrows
$$
\begin{array}{ccc}
X'&\xrightarrow{g'}&X\\
f'\downarrow&&\downarrow f\\
Y'&\xrightarrow{g}&Y
\end{array}
\qquad fg'=gf'.
$$
For each scheme $T$ in the square, use its small pro-etale site, constant coefficient ring sheaf $A_T$, and ambient unbounded category $D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For a morphism $u:U\to V$, use the canonical ring-sheaf isomorphism $c_u:u^{-1}A_V\xrightarrow{\sim}A_U$ [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map] and the derived module pullback $Lu_A^*:D(V_{\mathrm{proet}},A)\to D(U_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations].

For composable $h:Z\to W$ and $k:W\to V$, write
$$
\mu_{k,h,A}:=(c_{h,k}^{\mathrm{der}})^{-1}:
Lh_A^*Lk_A^*\xrightarrow{\sim}L(kh)_A^*,
$$
where $c_{h,k}^{\mathrm{der}}:L(kh)_A^*\xrightarrow{\sim}Lh_A^*Lk_A^*$ is the canonical isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition], specialized to the constant sheaves $A_V,A_W,A_Z$ with the identifications $c_k$ and $c_h$. The identification that this lemma gives $(kh)^{-1}A_V\cong A_Z$, namely $c_h\circ h^{-1}(c_k)$ composed with the canonical isomorphism $(kh)^{-1}\cong h^{-1}k^{-1}$, equals $c_{kh}$: both are ring-sheaf maps whose adjoints $A_V\to(kh)_*A_Z$ send each constant section $a$ to the constant section $a$ (the defining formula of $\rho$ in [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map], applied to $k$, $h$ and $kh$), and such a map is determined by its values on the constant presheaf, whose sheafification is $A_V$. Hence the functor $L(kh)^*$ of that lemma is $L(kh)_A^*$ as defined above. Define
$$
c_{\square,A}:=\mu_{f,g',A}^{-1}\circ\mu_{g,f',A}:
Lf'^*_ALg^*_A\xrightarrow{\sim}Lg'^*_ALf^*_A.
$$
In this formula the targets of $\mu_{g,f',A}$ and of $\mu_{f,g',A}$ are the same functor $Lu_A^*$, $u=gf'=fg'$, formed with the single identification $c_u$; no further identification is involved. Thus $c_{\square,A}$ is the specified natural isomorphism of functors $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)\to D(X'_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$; the notation $c_{\square,\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}$ means this same isomorphism.

mathlib_searches.query: Natural isomorphism comparing the two composites of derived inverse image functors on pro-etale sheaves with finite coefficients in a commutative square of schemes
mathlib_searches.results: The eight hits concern Scheme.Modules pseudofunctor composition and associativity, restrictFunctorComp, a condensed-set comparison, and SheafOfModules.freeFunctorCompPullbackIso. Read Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Modules/Sheaf.lean:233-250: its pullbackComp is for ordinary structure-sheaf modules, not unbounded pro-etale derived categories with constant finite coefficients.

Ten hits in Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/Proetale.lean and ElladicCohomology.lean. Read Proetale.lean:47-80: these define the topology and its comparison with the etale topology, not derived inverse-image composition or the square comparison.

mathlib_searches.query: The two composites of derived inverse image on proetale finite coefficient sheaves in a commutative square are canonically isomorphic
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits, including SheafOfModules.pullbackComp, sheafPushforwardContinuousComp inverse components, overMapPullbackComp and categorical pullback transport. Read Mathlib/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Sheaf/PullbackContinuous.lean:148-174: pullbackComp acts on ordinary sheaves of modules; passing to unbounded derived functors is additional content, not a one-line specialization.

Twelve hits, including Iso.self_symm_id, Iso.symm_self_id, Iso.trans_symm and whiskering coherence. These are generic operations on already supplied isomorphisms, not the required derived pullback-composition data.

Twenty-five hits: MonoOver.pullbackComp, Over.pullbackComp, locally Cartesian closed chosen-pullback coherence, leftDerivedNatTrans_comp and ordinary abelian left-derived natural transformation composition, plus Sites/PseudofunctorSheafOver. These do not supply the required unbounded derived inverse-image comparison on constant-coefficient pro-etale module sheaves.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits, including Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp and its pseudofunctor laws, SheafOfModules.pullbackComp and pullback_assoc. The source of the two pullbackComp definitions was read at Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Modules/Sheaf.lean:241 and Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Sheaf/PullbackContinuous.lean:167. Both are underived. No match for the required unbounded derived pro-etale construction.

mathlib_searches.query: Exact inverse image on sheaves of modules induces a functor on the unbounded derived category and respects composition
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: Ext.mapExactFunctor_hom, Ext.mapExactFunctor, Functor.mapDerivedCategory, mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh, mapDerivedCategoryFactors and associated linearity/lifting declarations. Independently read Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/DerivedCategory/ExactFunctor.lean:29-144. These provide the functor induced by an exact functor, not the composition/square comparison for pro-etale module pullbacks.

Six hits: mapDerivedCategoryFactors_hom_naturality at ExactFunctor.lean:47, mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh_hom_app at :66, their uses at :68, :101, :131, and Ext/Map.lean:75. No mapDerivedCategoryCompIso in this pinned source. Read ExactFunctor.lean:29-144; no exact leaf for the comparison definition.
